name: get_overview
description: Short, current summary of all Claude Code sessions and pending decisions.

name: get_session
description: One session's details and its last message.

name: reply_to_session
description: Pass the developer's instruction to a session (continue, do this, approved: submit it, etc.). Also resolves its pending question.

instruction.description: Clear instruction for the session, capturing the developer's intent

call_back.description: Call the developer back when this work finishes or gets stuck, even in desk mode. Default true for work given by phone; false only if the developer says not to call.

confirmed.description: Did the developer EXPLICITLY confirm this action by voice? false if not.

name: answer_permission
description: Answer a session's permission request (run a command, edit a file, etc.).

note.description: Optional note for the agent when denying

confirmed.description: Did the developer EXPLICITLY confirm this action by voice? false if not.

name: release_session
description: Release a waiting session with no new instruction; it stops normally.

name: start_session
description: Start a NEW Claude Code session in a project folder. Only when no session is open for that project, or the developer explicitly asks for a new/separate session.

call_back.description: Call the developer back when this work finishes or gets stuck, even in desk mode. Default true for work given by phone; false only if the developer says not to call.

new_session.description: true only if the developer explicitly asked for a NEW session although one is already open

confirmed.description: Did the developer EXPLICITLY confirm this action by voice? false if not.

name: call_me_when_done
description: Call the developer when a session finishes or gets stuck ("call me when it's done"). Works in every mode.

name: computer_task
description: Let the hub itself operate the Mac: click in the browser, submit a form, use an app. Can take a while; the result arrives later.

task.description: Precise description of what to do

confirmed.description: Did the developer EXPLICITLY confirm this action by voice? false if not.

name: ask_brain
description: Answer a question by reading session transcripts and projects (what a session did, what the error was, which files changed). Can take a while.

name: stop
description: Stop one session immediately, or all of them ("all" = panic).

name: resume_hub
description: Re-enable automatic actions after a panic/pause.

confirmed.description: Did the developer EXPLICITLY confirm this action by voice? false if not.

name: set_mode
description: Change when the hub may call: desk (I'm at the computer, no calls), away, ride (riding, extra short), sleep (emergencies only).

name: set_language
description: Change the language you speak and write summaries in, from the next call on. Use a BCP-47 code such as en-US, tr-TR, de-DE, es-ES.

name: auto_approve
description: From now on, approve a specific permission in a project without asking (e.g. "npm test", "Edit").

rule.description: Command prefix (e.g. "npm test") or tool name (e.g. "Edit")

confirmed.description: Did the developer EXPLICITLY confirm this action by voice? false if not.
